objective: Identify publication-time feature families that may represent scientific-paper innovation or potential later scholarly impact, without using future outcomes to admit features.

scope.unit: journal article, conference paper, or review article
excluded_from_predictors: features selected because they improve the target outcome

retrieval_design.query_plan: Twelve evidence domains, each containing six frozen concept searches, for 72 database-specific searches.
retrieval_design.openalex_role: Primary systematic discovery source using title, abstract, and indexed full-text search with complete cursor pagination.
retrieval_design.crossref_rest_role: DOI and bibliographic metadata validation, not exhaustive topical discovery because query matching is relevance-ranked and fuzzy.
retrieval_design.crossref_snapshot_role: Optional exhaustive Crossref metadata discovery by a local scan of a named annual public snapshot.
retrieval_design.no_top_k_rule: Formal retrieval has no result-count cap. Any operator-requested cap makes the run incomplete.
deduplication: normalized title plus publication year when DOI is absent
supplementary_routes: backward citation chaining from every included review and foundational source
forward citation chaining from all included construct-defining sources

methodological_standards.name: PRISMA-S
methodological_standards.citation: Rethlefsen ML et al. (2021). PRISMA-S: an extension to the PRISMA Statement for Reporting Literature Searches in Systematic Reviews. Systematic Reviews 10:39.
methodological_standards.role: complete reporting of databases, exact searches, dates, limits, counts, and deduplication

methodological_standards.name: PRESS 2015 Guideline
methodological_standards.citation: McGowan J et al. (2016). PRESS Peer Review of Electronic Search Strategies: 2015 Guideline Statement. Journal of Clinical Epidemiology 75:40-46.
methodological_standards.role: independent peer review of the electronic search strategy

methodological_standards.name: Cochrane Handbook Chapter 4
methodological_standards.role: text-term design, source coverage, deduplication, and citation chaining

record_screening.stage_1: Two researchers independently screen titles and abstracts against the frozen scope.
record_screening.stage_2: Two researchers independently inspect full text for an article-level indicator definition, timing boundary, data inputs, formula, and validation evidence.
record_screening.adjudication: Disagreements are resolved by a third recorded decision or a consensus meeting with reasons.
required_reporting: records excluded at each stage with reasons
Cohen kappa or an explicitly justified alternative
record_screening.automation_boundary: Machine-assisted prioritization may order records but may not silently exclude them from the denominator.

indicator_census.stage_a: Record every source-mentioned indicator concept, including unavailable, invalid, future-only, and adverse-evidence candidates.
indicator_census.stage_b: Merge aliases, formula variants, windows, encodings, transformations, and missingness flags into one canonical mathematical or categorical family.
indicator_census.stage_c: Verify each family against at least one primary application or foundational mathematical source; reviews provide discovery coverage but do not authorize a formula.
indicator_census.stage_d: Apply the frozen hard gates in the parent screening_rules.json without a dimension or indicator quota.
indicator_census.counting_unit: One construct-distinct mathematical or categorical feature family; a parameter, lag, threshold, transformation, interaction, or missing-value flag is not a new family.
indicator_census.saturation_diagnostic: Report the rolling number of new canonical families by screened batch. Saturation is diagnostic only and never permits unaccounted database hits.

dimension_rule.derivation: Dimensions are an evidence-backed coding frame seeded from reviews, then revised only when inductive indicator coding exposes a construct that cannot be placed without material loss.
dimension_rule.admission: A predictive dimension requires at least two independent peer-reviewed research groups plus at least one feature passing all hard gates; context controls retain the parent exemption.
dimension_rule.stability_check: Publish both the a-priori-to-indicator mapping and every later split, merge, rename, or rejected new dimension.

freeze: compiled query text and query hash
all cursors, page counts, totals, errors, and completion flags
reproducibility.formal_complete_condition: Every frozen query has complete=true, all retrieved records have final screening dispositions, all retained feature families have verified primary-source definitions, and required dual-coding fields are complete.
reproducibility.live_api_caveat: A rerun against a changing live database is version-equivalent only after comparing manifests; exact row identity is guaranteed by the frozen snapshot, not by the API.
